extreme.why: CoM 0.21 m above the axle (0.135 m on CAD/) and 4.4 kg: more roll in hard turns. Measured 5.2 deg nominal; limit 1.5x like the CAD/ limits

slalom.why: taller, heavier robot as for extreme. Measured 2.6 deg nominal; limit 1.5x

fall_fwd.why: 14 N does not topple a 4.4 kg robot (it recovers up to ~40 N). 50 N is clearly unrecoverable, as the scenario intends

fall_back.why: -12 N does not topple a 4.4 kg robot; -35 N falls promptly

fall_trip.why: 3 N m does not trip a 4.4 kg robot; scaled with mass (2.3x)
